rationale: The Latin anchors *vastare* (to lay waste), *abolere* (to destroy/obliterate), and *subvertere* (to overthrow/overturn) all point strongly to wholesale destruction and despoliation of a place rather than mere theft of goods. The synset rape.v.02 ("destroy and strip of its possessions") captures this sense of violent ruination, matching the Latin evidence far better than plunder.v.03, which focuses narrowly on stealing/looting.
